title: Compilation Is Not Correctness: Scan-by-Scan Evaluation of LLM-Generated PLC Programs
abstract: arXiv:2610.28675v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Programmable logic controllers (PLCs) automate industrial processes through repeated scans, each reading inputs, executing control logic, and updating outputs. Engineers write this logic in Structured Text (ST), a high-level textual language defined in IEC 61131-3. Large language models (LLMs) can now generate ST from natural-language requirements, yet compilation success and checks on selected properties or sampled scans can leave behavioral errors undetected. We introduce CycleBench, a benchmark of 301 ST tasks with behavioral requirements, public interfaces, reference programs, and executable scenarios. Its runtime executes each generated program and its reference under aligned inputs, initialization, and logical time, comparing their outputs after every scan. translated_title: 编译不等于正确性：对LLM生成的PLC程序的逐扫描周期评估
translated_abstract: 可编程逻辑控制器（PLC）通过重复的扫描周期来自动化工业过程，每个扫描周期读取输入、执行控制逻辑并更新输出。工程师使用结构化文本（ST）编写这种控制逻辑，ST是IEC 61131-3标准中定义的一种高级文本语言。大型语言模型（LLM）现在可以根据自然语言需求生成ST代码，然而仅依赖编译成功或对特定属性、抽样扫描周期的检查，可能会使行为错误未被发现。我们提出了CycleBench，这是一个包含301个ST任务的基准测试，涵盖行为需求、公共接口、参考程序和可执行场景。其运行时环境在对齐的输入、初始化和逻辑时间条件下执行每个生成的程序及其参考程序，并在每个扫描周期后比较它们的输出。在八个LLM和基线生成方法的测试中，执行通过率比编译通过率低11.92个百分点；观察到的失败案例包括输出更新错误、算术……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出CycleBench基准测试，通过逐扫描周期比较LLM生成的PLC程序与参考程序的行为输出，揭示编译通过率与实际执行通过率之间存在11.92个百分点的差距，证明编译成功并不代表程序正确。
en_tdlr: CycleBench, a benchmark of 301 ST tasks, evaluates LLM-generated PLC programs via scan-by-scan behavioral comparison against reference programs, revealing an 11.92 percentage-point gap between compilation pass rate and execution pass rate, showing that compilation success does not imply correctness.
